cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll sort out another birthday dinner. First, were you upset when Mum cancelled?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll answer, but you first. We can leave the dinner planning until after.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. Let's get our cake somewhere neither of us cried.

reason: Replace decorative authority with a planning agenda that A postpones to secure reciprocal disclosure; replace the malformed allergy joke with a concrete shared-embarrassment choice caused by B4.
